name: Instrumentation
description: Flight, warning, automatic flight and engine instruments in 38 chapters: pitot-static sources, air temperature, the air data instruments and computer, magnetism and compasses, gyroscopic instruments, inertial systems, radio altimeter, FMS and EFIS, data link, flight director, autopilot, autoland, autothrottle, yaw dampers and control laws, warning systems, GPWS and ACAS, flight recorders, and engine and electronic instrumentation.
